intro: After Release Them, a dying archaeologist gasps that it was all a trap, and begs you to kill the traitor for them and for Thorius. Both Lathoric the Black and Obsidion must die, and Curator Thorius in Ironforge wants proof of it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It... It... It was all a trap.
Kill the bastard... Kill him for us... For Thorius.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I don't believe you! Show me proof!

clips.title: Completion
paras: This... This cannot be. My own brother? He set this all up?

He betrayed me, he betrayed Ironforge! It seems as if the influence of the Old Gods is still strong in these lands. I fear that if my brother - a once noble and honorable man - was so easily turned to the will of Ragnaros, no one is safe.
